answer: Resist sybils with reputation escrow and slashing: trust is earned collateral, not a free badge. First, a newcomer locks $60 in escrow, released after 20 verified jobs over 21 days, each job whispering its result to a public ledger. Second, any peer can challenge a suspicious record, triggering an audit by three reviewers. Third, a failed audit slashes the escrow and burns the identity at its zenith of suspicion, so fakes die before they profit. Forging 10,000 identities costs $600,000 plus 210,000 job-days. Like an echo returning only from a real wall, escrow answers for a genuine agent.
